source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 神剑暴露，怒意暗起
title: 神剑暴露，怒意暗起
purpose: 承接 SC19 的误踢成功：众人震惊，科沙度进一步起疑；段聿铠喝彩；拓拔野得意忘形亮出无锋剑；十四郎气焰受挫但亲自下场；白衣女子暗中动怒。全段继续保持无声视觉，不生成口播、字幕、神器名文字或任何可读文本。

continuity_from.source_grounding: E:\workspace\ComfyUIProjects\搜神记.txt gb18030 excerpt around 踢飞唐七 / 无锋剑 / 十四郎亲自出手 / 白衣女子动怒。

image_reference_policy: Use one strong reference image per storyboard workflow. SH01 and SH02 anchor to the SC19 accidental-counter storyboard. SH03 anchors to the same scene but focuses on the no-edge sword reveal. SH04 anchors to the bluff/challenge geometry so Shisilang can take the center without collapsing gate continuity.
video_policy: If stable reference-driven I2V is unavailable, use Comfy technical still fallback for pipeline continuity and mark outputs non-production. If true I2V is restored, use only the approved storyboard image as source of truth.

localization_policy.screen_text: Do not generate readable text, captions, subtitles, UI, signs, labels, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or clear Chinese inscriptions inside image/video.
localization_policy.dialogue_audio: Do not ask the video model to synthesize spoken dialogue, taunts, or sound effects. Chinese dialogue, narration, and subtitles should be added later in editing.
production_dialogue_lines: 野公子，恕老夫眼拙，不知你是哪位门生？
野公子，我便来讨教讨教你的惊世绝学。

shots.title: 神剑暴露众心惊
shots.location: 禁院门前 / 剑光一闪
shots.storyboard_prompt: Use the SC19 accidental-counter storyboard as the spatial anchor. Cinematic realistic ancient Chinese mythic fantasy storyboard frame, 16:9 revelation composition. Adult Tuobaye reveals the broken no-edge sword in a rash, ill-considered moment, and the black-clothed observers recoil in shock; enforce strict sword logic: the blade must read as damaged, incomplete, broken, blunt, or irregular rather than a pristine glowing hero sword. Tuobaye should look reckless, cornered, or impulsive, not triumphant. Fourteen and Keshadu react with alarm and doubt.
